title: Research: two-mask five-cube cost 47 versus 48 under rank cap 14
body:
With every term capped at pairing rank 14, the five-cube code `C=span_F2{1,p,x0*x1,(1+x1)*x2}` has exact minimum total cost **47**, while every common one-mask subcode of this C either cannot decode or costs at least **48**. The attaining word has ranks **7+13+13+14**. This is a **scoped structural result / research note**, not a new kappa or physical supplier.

The package also certifies the complete rank-cap table for all **720** codes generated by two signed coordinate-product masks on distinct supports. There are three verified isometry classes. All retain unrestricted minimum 32; even the optimistic inherited stage budget is at most -32, so the constrained gain does not admit a positive supplier saving. An outside-family two-quadratic-mask fixture attains `8+8+8+8`, showing why the cap penalty cannot be generalized to arbitrary quadratic mask pairs.

The certificate covers arbitrary finite term counts through the complete 65,536-state dyad graph. A separately written checker uses Walsh-feature Gram construction, exact Fraction elimination, checked edge potentials and binary separating functionals. It imports no generator or predecessor code. Coverage: **675 ordered rational ranks, 737,280 transport-pair checks, 55,934,976 undirected edge inequalities, and 11 negative controls**. Attaining words are checked on all 1,024 port pairs.

Reproduce offline with Python 3.10+:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/five-cube-two-product-masks/verify.py
```

Expected final marker: `PASS_FIVE_CUBE_TWO_PRODUCT_MASKS codes=720 orbits=3 ranks=675 controls=11 pins=2 no_new_kappa`.

The [proof, scope, and rank-cap table](https://github.com/bbMisk/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4faed28a0e6c8a0aa5faa87b281b9373fb5d8403/research/five-cube-two-product-masks/README.md), certificate, readable receipt, exact source pins, task card, overlap record and execution logs are all in the package. The registered Python 3.12 replay passes, as do four package tests, selected-record integrity, and five selected-record regression tests. Regeneration is byte-identical; optimized standalone relocation and source/certificate corruption controls pass. No full selected-supplier cold replay, hosted CI pass, proof-assistant verification or independent human review is claimed.

Base **410026dc5513b87db92ae98571d1d5984c69a983**; OS seed **44**, structural decoder track. Only `research/five-cube-two-product-masks/` is added. Final overlap checks covered 798 open PRs and 168 discussion records with complete pagination, and reconfirmed main at `e6f9716621f4e01fc190617934cdfaf072bd976f`. The selected result and pinned inputs are unchanged. No pinned sprint issue existed, so the donor's local-claim fallback was used.

Credit @martinxxx9's **PR1046**, Ross Richardson's **PR958/1177**, **PR1222**, Joel Pulikkan / GamingPuzzled's **PR231**, icekylinx/eumemic and the retained DreamingOfClouds/Jacob Sussman/Zhihao Chen copy/frame lineage. PR1222 at `c6fe323581d3803a080b000b263a07edf2b00b54` treats one quadratic mask; PR1177 at `e878ef36109bc6d7e21e62d03c22d8ec36f6f936` allows at most three terms. The four-term two-mask witness and its exact comparison are outside both scopes; neither pending result is a theorem premise.

Prepared by **Hanson Sun (@bbMisk)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance** in research, proof, both implementations, verification and writing. Apache-2.0. Physical realization, all-size/compiler, hosting, precision/tape, bit interfaces and analytic transfer remain outside the result.
